entities.name: Capture of Kiev by the White Army

entities.summary: The Capture of Kiev by the White Army occurred on 30 August [O.S. 18 August] 1919 and was one of several battles fought in Kiev, the capital of Ukraine in 1919 during the Russian Civil War, in which the White Army captured the city from the Red Army without a fight.
